audience: training managers who run courses, learning paths and certifications in Axis LMS

useCases.title: See who is doing what in a course
useCases.text: The AI reads a course report: each user's status, progress, score, start and completion date, and lists the users enrolled with their access dates.

useCases.title: Find certifications that expire soon
useCases.text: The AI reads the certifications issued in a program with number, issue, renewed and expire dates, and the certifications one user holds.

useCases.title: Review a learner's courses, certifications and ILT
useCases.text: The AI finds a user and reads their transcript: course status, progress and score, certifications, instructor-led training and learning paths.

useCases.title: Enroll users in or remove them from courses and paths
useCases.text: The AI enrolls a user in an online course or learning path, or removes them. For a course it can set access start and end dates.

useCases.title: Enroll or remove ILT users and record attendance
useCases.text: The AI checks the seats left in a session, enrolls a user (or removes them), and marks the user attended or absent for one meeting.

useCases.title: Create users and groups, update users, add members
useCases.text: The AI creates a user, changes profile fields, creates a usergroup and adds users to it. Groups can drive course or path assignments.
